title: Galaxies
info: Galaxies are enormous groups of stars, gas, and dust.
Shapes include spiral, elliptical, and irregular. The Milky Way is a spiral.
Andromeda is the nearest large galaxy. It and the Milky Way sit in a small neighborhood called the Local Group.
